name: uberasm-save-at-any-time-on-overworld
title: Save At Any Time On Overworld
description:
This handy UberASM gives you a couple different options for allowing you to save the game at any time on the overworld:

- Autosave when you move on the overworld and when exiting a level.
- Bring up the save prompt with a configurable button.
- Save upon pressing a configurable button.

It'll also optionally display an icon to indicate the game has saved.

This has two small hijacks that enable the save icon to appear when using the save prompt and when the intro march finishes for consistency.

Insert on all your overworld maps using *. Also, use this tweak to fix an edge case where the game will not autosave after clearing an event if both Mario doesn't move afterwards and the level is not a "No-Auto-Move" level. Also insert this patch to fix a vanilla quirk that can prevent the save icon from displaying.

Made for Yano_Felix.
